data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate closed 2017 gross claims outstanding at GBP 92.031m (opening for 2018). During 2018 the gross claims outstanding increased materially to GBP 185.769m, but a substantial element of the change reflects the transfer of reserves from Syndicate 1955 (15.4% of 2015 & prior years) into the 2016 year of account, which distorts comparisons and claims development analysis. The Syndicate also suffered named 2018 catastrophe losses (Hurricanes Michael and Florence, Typhoon Jebi and California wildfires) which the report states adversely impacted profit by GBP 3.2m. Because of the RITC/reserve transfer and lack of an explicit gross prior-year movement figure, no single authoritative gross prior-year development amount is reported here.
raw_causal_phrases: The increase in the year was due to 15.4% of the 2015 and prior year of account of reserves from Syndicate 1955 being transferred into the 2016 year of account of Syndicate 1856.

The Syndicate underperformed due to the continued soft market and was also affected by the Active Underwriter and US Property Underwriter leaving during 2018. Hurricanes Michael and Florence, Typhoon Jebi and California Wildfires adversely impacted the Syndicate's profit by GBP 3.2m.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross prior-year movement ('Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding') figure was found. A gross claims development triangle exists but is materially distorted by a transfer of reserves from Syndicate 1955 into the 2016 year of account (RITC), making triangle-derived prior-year development unreliable. Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is set to null. Gross and segmental figures were taken from the statutory segmental analysis and technical provisions notes; units in the claims triangle are shown in GBP 000 in the report.
